name: Bronwen Davies
bio:
Bronwen Davies didn't initially envision a career in motorsport, but a lifelong fascination with technology and a fortunate encounter at a local rally event changed everything. Starting as a junior programmer at a small tech firm, she quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating a knack for problem-solving and a keen understanding of complex systems. When the opportunity arose to apply her skills to the world of racing, she jumped at the chance.

At Toyota Gazoo Racing BR, Bronwen is responsible for ensuring the team's IT infrastructure runs smoothly, from data acquisition systems to communication networks. Her approach is methodical and proactive, anticipating potential issues before they arise. A strong believer in collaboration, she works closely with engineers and strategists to provide them with the tools and information they need to make informed decisions. Her ability to see the 'big picture' while maintaining a meticulous attention to detail is what sets her apart.

Bronwen’s calm demeanour and unwavering loyalty have made her a respected figure within the team. She takes pride in mentoring younger members of the IT department, sharing her knowledge and experience to help them grow. When not immersed in server logs and network diagrams, she can be found tending to her garden or hiking the Welsh hills.

physical.description: Bronwen is a woman of average height, with a warm smile and kind eyes that reflect her approachable nature.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard with clicky switches.
Has a collection of vintage computer magazines in her office.
